summary: The SDD controller finished all four tasks. It reviewed each task before starting the next, ran a final whole-branch review with a fix and a re-review, and ended at the finishing step. There were 11 auto-compactions along the way. After each one the controller re-read its loop files, and the implement → review order held. npm test passes: 69 tests, 0 failures.
reasoning: All four criteria are backed by evidence on disk and in the session log. The task loop held through repeated compactions: every task was reviewed before the next started, the final review ran, and the session ended in the finishing step.

observations.description: The session log has 11 compact_boundary entries (22:52 to 23:14), about one every 2 minutes. That is far more often than 'after the first task'. The controller recovered every time; the screen showed 'Next I'm claiming Task 3 and re-reading task-loop.md and implementer-prompt.md, since compaction dropped my earlier copies'.

I chose 'Keep the branch as-is', but the finishing step detached HEAD at ffd6d7a and released the branch lease, so feature/textstats is no longer checked out. The agent told me to run `git switch feature/textstats`. A user asking to keep things as-is probably wouldn't expect their checkout to change.
A fix subagent left behind an untracked backup file, test/topWords.test.js.bak. The agent pointed it out but did not clean it up.

Before Task 1, the agent stopped to ask a multiple-choice question about gaps between the plan's prose and its test code. I answered through the 'Type something' option with 'Proceed as you recommend.' The question was reasonable, but it is a blocking interruption at the start of the run.

Startup dialogs: the trust prompt and the bypass-permissions prompt both default to 'No, exit'. An 'Update to Opus 5.5?' prompt appeared even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5 (it said the pinned model was Opus 5). I answered No, and the header then showed Opus 5.5.
Codex is not installed, so every Codex review gate was recorded as skipped. The agent disclosed this clearly.

criteria.criterion: All four functions exported from src/textstats.js, each with its test file, committed, and npm test passes
criteria.evidence: src/textstats.js:141 `module.exports = { wordCount, sentenceCount, topWords, readingTimeMinutes };`. test/ contains wordCount/sentenceCount/topWords/readingTimeMinutes .test.js. git log shows commits 90f517d feat: add wordCount, 9b70396 sentenceCount, ed06856 topWords, 3e0e9c8 readingTimeMinutes, ffd6d7a test fix. npm test: `tests 69 … pass 69 fail 0`.

criteria.criterion: Each task reviewed before the next task starts
criteria.evidence: Agent dispatches in session log c57d217f….jsonl, in order: Implement Task 1, Review Task 1 (spec + quality), Implement Task 2, Review Task 2, Implement Task 3, Review Task 3, Implement Task 4, Review Task 4.

criteria.evidence: Session log dispatches after Review Task 4: 'Final whole-branch review', 'Fix final-review findings', 'Re-review final fix wave'. Screen: 'Agent "Final whole-branch review" finished · 56s'.

Screen: 'I'm using the finishing-a-development-branch skill…' followed by the options Merge / PR / Keep. I replied 'Keep the branch as-is'. Agent: 'I've kept branch feature/textstats as it is, at ffd6d7a. Nothing was merged or pushed'.
